data.title: Adding Two-Digit Numbers Without Regrouping
data.description: Practice adding two-digit numbers using base-ten blocks and the standard algorithm without needing to regroup.

challenges.hint: Add the ones column first, then add the tens column.
challenges.narration: Let's add 23 and 14 together by combining the ones and tens!

challenges.hint: Start with 1 + 2 in the ones place.
challenges.narration: Great job! Now let's try 31 plus 42.

challenges.hint: Check the ones place: 3 + 4 is less than 10, so no regrouping needed.
challenges.narration: You are doing fantastic. Here is our final addition problem: 53 + 24.

wordProblemContext.imagePrompt: Friendly cartoon teacher with base-ten blocks on a wooden table
wordProblemContext.story: You are organizing two groups of items for the classroom. Combine them to find the total sum!
